hypotheses.text: If Theo Varga had shot instead of passing, the immediate chance to score would have been lower than the 11.0% created by his pass to Ondo.
If Theo Varga had carried the ball forward rather than passing, the immediate chance to score on that sequence would have been lower than the 11.0% produced by the assist.
If Theo Varga had passed to Ilan Moreau (CM) instead of Ondo, the resulting chance to score would have been lower than the 11.0% created by the actual pass.
